records.boundary_description: Six Kyushu provinces: Satsuma, Osumi, Hyuga, Buzen, Bungo, and Hizen.
records.notes: One-sided diagnostic only. Historical-to-EU5 polygon equivalence must be audited before scoring; this cannot calibrate global scale.

records.label: Otrar oasis irrigated population
pressure_evidence: Archaeological irrigation reconstruction links settlement to maintained canals and cultivable floodplain.
records.food_regime: irrigated cereals, oasis horticulture, livestock, and riverine foods
records.boundary_description: Published Otrar oasis archaeological province; EU5 province selector is provisional.

records.label: Pingjiang (Suzhou) Yuan register around 1290
pressure_evidence: Dense irrigated rice, canal transport, and Taihu fisheries supported an unusually populous landscape; saturation pressure is not independently resolved.
records.food_regime: irrigated rice, wheat and legumes, Taihu fisheries, pigs, and canal redistribution
records.boundary_description: Pingjiang Lu six-county administrative unit; EU5 province selector is provisional.
records.notes: Thriving irrigated validation case. High trade and unresolved saturation evidence prohibit scale training.

records.label: Tibetan enumerations in the 1260-1287 period
pressure_evidence: High-altitude barley and pastoral systems impose ecological constraints, but local saturation pressure is not resolved.
records.food_regime: high-altitude barley, yak and sheep pastoralism, pulses, and localized trade
records.boundary_description: Historical Tibet; EU5 region selector is only a broad proxy.
records.notes: Broad highland validation only; no saturation fraction is inferred.

records.label: Fayyum villages in al-Nabulusi's 1245 cadastral survey
records.metric_semantics: Tax assessments and partial poll-tax heads; not total production or total population.
pressure_evidence: Village-level tax, irrigation rights, crops, and landholding data expose local resource pressure and water allocation.
shock_flags: Poll-tax sample excludes converted Muslim population
Tax quantities are assessed dues rather than production
records.food_regime: Nile basin wheat, barley, beans, rice, irrigation, livestock, and local market agriculture
records.boundary_description: Published triangular Fayyum depression and approximately 100 villages; no audited EU5 selector.
records.notes: High-value physical and food-system packet with no population label. The missing total population is intentional and blocks quantitative scoring.

records.label: Nile basin gravity and basin-irrigation capability by 1337
pressure_evidence: Fayyum cadastral evidence and Nile irrigation literature document water control, land rights, and cereal/legume production, but not a total equilibrium population.
shock_flags: Plague and political disruption in the target-era Nile corridor
records.food_regime: basin irrigation, wheat, barley, legumes, rice in suitable pockets, livestock, and fisheries
records.boundary_description: Lower and Upper Egypt river corridor; broad EU5 Egypt region is not an equivalent settlement boundary.
records.notes: Capability evidence only. It affects the physical water allocator, never a regional population target or hand-authored multiplier.

records.label: Lower Tigris-Euphrates canal and drainage landscape by 1337
pressure_evidence: Archaeological and remote-sensing studies document canal, drainage, and settlement systems in southern Mesopotamia; they do not establish a 1337 equilibrium population interval.
records.food_regime: gravity-irrigated cereals, dates, legumes, livestock, and riverine foods
records.boundary_description: Lower Tigris-Euphrates alluvial canal landscape; EU5 Iraq Arabi is only a provisional physical-system mask.
records.notes: Technology and land-system evidence only. Capacity must come from the mechanistic allocator with canal maintenance and salinity constraints; no population label is invented.
